data.description: 在异星模拟生态种植舱的恒温苗圃旁，佩丽卡蹲下身子，极其专注地观察着第一株破土而出的绿色嫩芽。她转过脸向你露出极其罕见的温柔浅笑——「看，管理员。即便是在这片严酷的荒原上，只要给予足够的耐心与养分，生命也依然能够倔强地生根发芽。」
data.promptProse: Squatting beside a climate-controlled raised planter inside an Endfield botanical greenhouse, Perlica wears her cyan-piped white cropped work jacket and charcoal utility trousers. Reaching gently near a tiny green sprout pushing cleanly out of dark soil, she turns back over her shoulder to share a rare, quiet smile with the viewer. Warm overhead grow-lights bathe the glass canopy, metal beds, and tender green leaves.
data.title: 佩丽卡 · 生态舱
data.animaCaption: Squatting beside the greenhouse planter bed in her cyan-piped white work jacket, Perlica turns from a tiny green sprout to offer the viewer a gentle, rare smile. Warm overhead grow-lights illuminate the glass module and fresh soil around her.
